verdict.rationale: Yubico documents a public YubiEnterprise 'YubiKey as a Service' REST API for fleet delivery, inventory and shipment management. That covers part of lifecycle tracking. Its official ykman CLI provides fully scriptable device configuration (applications, PINs, PIV/OATH/OTP slots), which can be automated toward bulk configuration. The evidence is probe-level summaries rather than in-depth admin docs, and community users describe manual per-account replacement and no record of where a key was enrolled. Missing for 10: documented pre-registration/enrollment of keys on users' behalf, a first-party bulk-provisioning workflow beyond per-device CLI scripting, detailed lifecycle states (assignment, revocation, retirement), and independent hands-on corroboration of fleet management.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can provision keys across an organization at scale — pre-registration, bulk configuration, and lifecycle tracking of issued keys

citations.quote: the documented programmatic surface for fleet delivery, inventory, and shipment management
Full scriptable device management: enable applications, PINs, PIV/OATH/OTP slots, device info.
Configure your YubiKey via the command line.
